# Repository instructions

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before changing this repository. It contains the architecture, PeopleTools 8.62 target, privacy boundaries, validation commands, and rules for the local legacy source.

Keep Chrome and Firefox builds in parity as required by `AGENTS.md` and [`docs/browser-support.md`](../docs/browser-support.md).

For prompt-pack work, also follow [`agents/AGENTS.md`](../agents/AGENTS.md). The prompt pack is separate from the browser extension.
